title: Failure-signal enrichment and protocol-normalized error dashboard
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a protocol-normalized error dashboard and augment tracing/metrics pipelines so every inference failure can be attributed to a single canonical failure class (timeout, overload, model_reject, model_error, grpc_code, http_code, infra_retry). The goal is to give oncall and SREs a single-pane view that shows root cause by layer (client, proxy, runtime, model) and a time-aligned sequence of events with enriched fields (inference_request_id, model_variant, kv_cache_hit, batch_id, node_id). This ticket covers pipeline changes, trace hook updates, dashboard panels, and runbook mapping to automated mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics pipeline emits protocol-normalized metric label 'failure_reason' for all failed requests
Tracing hooks populate 'inference.request_id', 'failure_reason', and 'failure_stage' for sampled & non-sampled paths
Dashboard shows stacked failure_reason breakdown over time, per-model variant, and per-region with drilldowns to traces
Alerting rules updated to use failure_reason slices and reduce noisy SLO alerts (examples documented)
Automated remediation playbook links visible from dashboard; at least one playbook (timeout -> increase client deadline vs fallthrough) validated in staging
implementation_steps: Define canonical failure taxonomy and mapping table (timeout, overload, model_reject, model_error, grpc_4xx, grpc_5xx, http_4xx, http_5xx, infra_retry) -> Confluence doc
Add normalization layer to metrics exporter: when exporter sees grpc/http status map to canonical 'failure_reason' label
Instrument runtime to attach 'failure_stage' (client|proxy|runtime|model|infra) to trace span when a failure path is taken
Update log processor (vector/tempo) to enrich logs with inference_request_id and map textual errors to failure_reason using ruleset
Build Grafana panels: protocol-normalized time series, per-model heatmap, failure provenance timeline, and top-k traces table
Wire dashboard drilldowns to trace UI and to the automated playbook links (PagerDuty/Runbook)
Run a 48h staging validation load with synthetic workload covering timeouts, overload, and model rejects to validate labeling correctness
Iterate on noisy-metric suppression and refine alert thresholds based on staging results
outstanding_risks: Misclassification of complex multi-hop failures (e.g., proxy + model_reject) leading to wrong remediation guidance
High cardinality from new labels (model_variant + batch_id) could increase costs in metrics backend
Tracing sampling may miss short-lived failures unless we add a low-overhead non-sampled enrichment path
Rollout coordination required with Dedicated and Private teams to ensure labels are emitted consistently across deployment modes
notes: Related work: ENG-4821 (failure taxonomy baseline), ENG-7246 (trace enrichment pipeline)
Design review feedback (2026-03-05): prefer a single 'failure_reason' label vs. multiple boolean flags to simplify queries; agreed to keep 'failure_stage' separately
Oncall playbooks to link: Increase client deadline, circuit-breaker adjust, model fallback -> doc at https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Error+Playbooks
Cost mitigation: use metric rollups for high-cardinality tag combos and keep raw detail for 7 days only
Follow-up: add an SDK contract test to verify exporters from private deployments include normalized failure_reason
